label: Book a time
summary: Books the chosen time for the caller (asks for their name and email first).

defaults.name: event_type_id
defaults.label: Event type id
defaults.help: The number in the event type's link in Cal.com (Event Types → the event → its id).

definition.name: booking_create
definition.description: Book a time the caller chose from booking_check_availability. Read the time and email back and get a yes before calling.

event_type_id.description: The Cal.com event type to book (leave out to use the agent's default).

start.description: The chosen start time as given by booking_check_availability (ISO 8601).

email.description: The caller's email address (spell it back first).

time_zone.description: The caller's IANA time zone, from the time note in your instructions (e.g. Europe/London).
